en: I sweated a lot in the hall.
I did not sweat in this cold.
You sweated when you ran a lot.
You did not sweat in the sauna yesterday.
You sweated when you were in the sun.
You did not sweat even though it was hot.
He sweated a lot at work.
He did not sweat even though he played football.
She sweated when she walked a lot.
She did not sweat with us in the hammam.
We sweated a lot on the bus.
We did not sweat in this room.
You sweated in the forest yesterday.
You did not sweat even though you walked on foot.
They sweated a lot during the match.
The children did not sweat in the cold.
I sweat a lot in the summer.
I do not sweat when it is cold.
You sweat quickly in the sun.

lat: nta ma kat3reqsh f l-bit dyalek
en: You do not sweat in your room.
You sweat when you run here.

lat: nti ma kat3erqish f had l-blasa
en: You do not sweat in this place.
He sweats when he works here.

lat: huwa ma kay3reqsh f l-khdma dyalu
en: He does not sweat at his job.
She sweats in the kitchen always.
She does not sweat at night.
We sweat when it is hot.
We do not sweat in this cold.
You sweat a lot in the classroom.

lat: ntuma ma kat3erqush wakha katmshiw bzaf
ar: نتوما ما كتعرقوش وخا كتمشيو بزاف
en: You do not sweat even though you walk a lot.
They sweat a lot on the train.

lat: huma ma kay3erqush f had l-waqt
en: They do not sweat at this time.
I will sweat a lot on the way.

lat: ma ghadish n3req f d-dar l-yum
en: I will not sweat at home today.

lat: nta ghadi t3req f sh-shems ghedda
en: You will sweat in the sun tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish t3req ila glesti hna
ar: ما غاديش تعرق إيلا جلستي هنا
en: You will not sweat if you sit here.

lat: nti ghadi t3erqi ila lbesti l-mantu
ar: نتي غادي تعرقي إيلا لبستي المانطو
en: You will sweat if you wear the coat.

lat: ma ghadish t3erqi f had l-makan
en: You will not sweat in this place.

lat: huwa ghadi y3req f l-matsh ghedda
en: He will sweat during the match tomorrow.

lat: huwa ma ghadish y3req f t-tumubil
en: He will not sweat in the car.

lat: hiya ghadi t3req melli ghadi tejri
ar: هي غادي تعرق ملي غادي تجري
en: She will sweat when she runs.

lat: hiya ma ghadish t3req f s-sba7
en: She will not sweat in the morning.
We will sweat in the hammam tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish n3erqu b l-lil hna
en: We will not sweat at night here.

lat: ntuma ghadi t3erqu ila mshitu daba
ar: نتوما غادي تعرقو إيلا مشيتو دابا
en: You will sweat if you leave now.

lat: ntuma ma ghadish t3erqu f l-ghaba
en: You will not sweat in the forest.

lat: huma ghadi y3erqu f had s-sehd
en: They will sweat in this heat.

lat: huma ma ghadish y3erqu m3ana l-yum
ar: هما ما غاديش يعرقو معانا اليوم
en: They will not sweat with us today.
